operation.description:
Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner configured in a
repository. Returns the remaining read-only labels from the runner.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/parameters/runner-id.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.
#/components/parameters/runner-id.name: runner_id

#/components/schemas/runner-label.description: A label for a self hosted runner

type.description: The type of label. Read-only labels are applied automatically when the runner is configured.

#/components/schemas/runner-label.title: Self hosted runner label
